proposals.before: He then pushed on west to Ferghana.
proposals.after: He then pushed on west to Dayuan (Ferghana).
proposals.reason: Chinese writes 大苑 (variant of 大宛); keeping Dayuan clarifies the polity name while retaining Ferghana.

proposals.before: Yewang set his inspector on Bing; Zhao Du of Shuyi proved ten jin of embezzled gold and moved to arrest him.
proposals.after: Yewang directed his regional inspector clerk Shi Shutao and Zhao Du to investigate; they proved Bing's crime of embezzling ten jin of gold while in office, and arrested him.
proposals.reason: Chinese 督郵掾示殳祤趙都 most naturally names clerks 示殳祤 and 趙都; the current English collapses them into one person 'Zhao Du of Shuyi'.

decisions.reason: 大苑 (standard 大宛) is already rendered accurately as Ferghana in this chapter’s English, matching s0029–s0030; inserting Dayuan is stylistic clarification, not correction of a mistranslation.

decisions.after: Yewang directed his regional inspector clerk Zhao Du of Duiyu to investigate; he proved Bing's crime of embezzling ten jin of gold while in office, and arrested him.
decisions.reason: Chapter 示殳祤 looks like a corrupt split of 祋 (示+殳) before 祤; Wikisource and CText read 祋祤趙都—one duyuan clerk, Zhao Du of Duiyu county—not two men. The proposal invents Shi Shutao; the original rightly keeps a single agent but misromanizes the county as Shuyi.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 野王部督郵掾祋祤趙都案驗
